reviews.title: Don’t waste your time
reviews.text: Buy a new phone and have to log back in??  Can’t do it without paying for a subscription-THERE IS NO PLACE TO LOG IN!!!!!

reviews.title: Interruptions
reviews.text: This is the 3rd time this has popped up as I’m shopping…in 5 minutes!

reviews.title: No more family sharing
reviews.text: I have had Grocery Gadget for over ten years and the best thing about it was being able to share the shopping list with my family. All of a sudden the family sharing is gone!!! Ok I understand they came out with their own family plan. Not happy they didn’t warn me about the family sharing stopping. I signed up for the family plan and I still won’t be able to share the shopping list until it renews in December, 2 months from now. Great way to treat a long time customer.

reviews.title: Ads in your search list!
reviews.text:
I paid for no ads, then the ads started showing up at the bottom. Now ads are showing up in your search list as though they were items you regularly order!

Sleazy developer! Don’t buy!

reviews.title: Alas…..
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Grocery Gadget for years probably since you first started programming it. I’ve never been able to get my app to merge both the stay on my phone and the data in the group. I just tried for maybe the 30th time (call me crazy?) and I’m now stuck in an endless loop of syncing that never goes anywhere and is holding my app hostage so I can’t use it.  Incredibly frustrating. 

It would be very helpful to be able to establish a new “store” independent of your list. I’ve never figured out how to enter my own version of “store” and it’s been very frustrating because there are other lists I would like to make than grocery stores or other actual stores.  Personal lists. 

I have loved this app and have used it every time I’ve been to the grocery store for years. But the syncing issue is an extremely frustrating one. My husband and I try to sync the same list in the same group on our phones and have never seemed to be able to sync well enough to get the job done.

I, too have searched for a user manual. I haven’t tried this time, because I’ve read other reviews in which people complain about the lack of one. I would appreciate more responsiveness from the programmers.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: Can’t update paid subscription, lost all data have had for years. Nobody responds to my queries.
